title: Development of a Halogen Free Flame Retardant Masterbatch for Polypropylene Fibers
authors: François Rault; Stéphane Giraud; Fabien Salaün; Xavier Almeras
TGA_specimen_preparation: Approximately 10 mg fibers of the prepared nonwoven fabrics, under nitrogen 50 mL/min, 20–600 °C at 10 °C/min. TG pan, aliquot cutting, conditioning and replication unreported.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Section 3.3: thermal stability of the fibers of the nonwoven fabrics; Figure 3 caption calls them loaded iPP fibers. Section 3.1 selects 290 g/m² nonwovens for the composition study.
LOI_method: Own measured limiting oxygen index, O2 vol%; abstract, introduction and section 3.4 describe LOI tests/measurements. Instrument and standard unreported.
LOI_specimen_preparation: Prepared 290 g/m² needle-punched nonwoven fabrics from source multifilaments; source does not state LOI strip dimensions, mounting, ignition protocol, conditioning or replication.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Section 3.3 p 228 explicitly gives onset at 5% mass loss for mf1–mf5; Table 5 p 229 gives measured LOI ±0.5. Original recipe, method, numerical prose/table and TG/DTG pixels inspected; no values estimated from plots.
conditions_locator: Sections 2.1–2.5.3 pp 222–226; Tables 1/2 p 224; section 3.1 p 227
TG_locator: Section 3.3 p 228, Figure 3 p 229; TGA method section 2.5.2 p 225
LOI_locator: Table 5 and section 3.4 p 229; own-measurement statements abstract p 220 and introduction p 222
source_location: Complete original publisher PDF pp 220–234, including methods, Tables 1–7, Figures 1–4, discussion, conclusions and references; recipe/method/assay pages 223–225 and 227–229 checked as pixels.
limitations: Five initial needle-punched nonwoven states are represented. The source explicitly calls the degradation onset a temperature at 5% weight loss in section 3.3, so these values are recorded as T5, not as an undefined tangent onset. Table 5 reports measured LOI values with ±0.5; the uncertainty type, LOI replicate count, instrument, standard, specimen dimensions and conditioning are unreported. The two replicated experiments in section 2.5.3 refer to cone calorimetry, and the five thickness readings in section 2.4 do not define LOI replication. Section 3.1 explicitly selects 290 g/m² nonwovens for the formulation comparison; section 3.3 describes TG of fibers of those nonwoven fabrics and Table 5 gives their LOI. The earlier 200 g/m² nonwoven, jersey and rib structures have no matched own LOI–TG pairs and are excluded. The source says no char remains above 510 °C for mf1 and above 500 °C for treated samples, but these qualitative statements are not converted into numerical zero residues. The treated DTG maxima are reported only as a group range of 473–480 °C and are not assigned to individual states. Table 4 contains DSC melting/crystallization data, not TG temperatures. Spin-finish chemistry and amount, TG pan, detailed fiber aliquot cutting and TG/LOI preconditioning are unreported. MPh is described as an approximately 85:15 mixture of aluminum phosphinate and phosphate ester, with its exact formulation confidential; nominal feed fractions are not measured retained add-on. Section 3.1 contains conflicting prose about the separate FMVSS behavior of the 290 g/m² mf5 fabric; Table 3 and Table 7 both report 89 mm/min. That burning-rate inconsistency does not replace either own TG or measured LOI. No durability washing is reported or assigned.
sample_state: mf1; initial 290 g/m² PP nonwoven; feed 100 wt% iPP, 0 wt% MC, 0 wt% MPh
composition: 100 wt% isotactic polypropylene, 0 wt% melamine cyanurate (MC), 0 wt% MPh aluminum-phosphinate/phosphate-ester mixture, per Table 1 nominal feed composition.
washing_state: Initial manufactured nonwoven; no durability wash reported
treatment_chemistry: No flame-retardant additive; virgin iPP control
treatment_method: Commercial isotactic polypropylene Borealis HG420 FB, source melt flow index 25 g/10 min. For additive formulations, two separate masterbatches were made from 60 wt% PP and 40 wt% MC or MPh by hand mixing and Thermo Haake co-rotating intermeshing twin-screw extrusion (16 mm, L/D 25; five zones 110/170/200/200/200 °C; 150 rpm), then pelletized. Virgin or formulated PP was melt spun with Spinboy I, single-screw temperature gradient 220–230 °C and pump flow 100 cm³/min; filaments were air cooled, spin finish applied, then drawn on rolls at 70/80 °C and 200/600 rpm, theoretical draw ratio 3. Winding matched the second roll; yarns contained 80 circular continuous filaments, overall approximately 1500 dtex. For each fabric, 200 g crimped fibers hand-cut to 50 mm were roller carded, rotated 90°, carded again, layered and needle punched. The formulation comparison uses the 290 g/m² nonwoven, thickness 2.8 mm. Crimping parameters and spin-finish composition are unreported.
source_MPh_composition_raw: Inorganic aluminum phosphinates mixed with phosphate ester in about 85:15 weight ratio; about 30% phosphorus; exact composition confidential.
source_spin_finish_raw: Applied to the filaments before drawing rolls; composition and amount unreported.
source_onset_definition: Onset temperature at 5% weight loss; section 3.3 then compares each formulation with mf1 Tonset.
source_DTG_peak_raw: mf1 main decomposition peak 466 °C; maximum rate 15.1%/min
pairing_evidence: Table 1 defines mf1 composition. Section 3.1 selects 290 g/m² nonwovens for the ratio comparison, section 3.3 explicitly assays fibers of these nonwoven fabrics and reports mf1 onset 375 °C under its defined 5% weight-loss criterion; Table 5 repeats mf1 with measured LOI 17.9 ±0.5. No wash or additional formulation is inserted between those assays.
